content.text: Skip to content Home > Destinations > Villanova University Villanova UniversityDelaware County, Montgomery County+−Leaflet | © OpenMapTiles © OpenStreetMap contributors Villanova is a community in the United States Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. It straddles Lower Merion Township in Montgomery County and Radnor Township in Delaware County. Villanova University is a Catholic university founded in 1842 by the Order of Saint Augustine. Named after Saint Thomas of Villanova, the school is the oldest Catholic university in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. How to Get ThereGet there on SEPTA. Hop the Paoli/Thorndale Line to Villanova or the Norristown High Speed Line to Villanova Station. Bus Route 106 also serves Villanova University. So many ways!
